messages:
incidents-bot: Pager: runtime-service model-runner on node inference-eu-3 reporting elevated 5xx and kernel OOMs. Severity P2. Auto-pager to #incidents
maria: noticing ~12% 502s across eu-west customer routes; spikes started ~00:52 UTC. Some requests time out before 5xx.
derek: I'm oncall, joining. Any deploys to model-runner in last 6h? @siva
siva: no code deploys. Autoscaler triggered at 00:50 for traffic surge, added nodes
olivia: dmesg shows repeated segfaults in libquant_attn.so and subsequent OOM kills. attaching truncated stack
maria: k8s shows pod restarts and node eviction on inference-eu-3. RSS and minor pagefaults climb prior to crash
derek: can we capture core and latest backtrace before pod restart? If not, grab previous logs + gdb bt
siva: running:
```
kubectl -n prod logs model-runner-9b2 --previous | tail -n 800 > /tmp/mr-prev.log
kubectl -n prod exec model-runner-9b2 -- gdb -batch -ex "thread apply all bt" /usr/bin/model-runner > /tmp/mr-bt.log || true
``` 
maria: also snapshot /proc/slabinfo and run `dmesg -T | tail -n 200`
incidents-bot: note: automated fallback to model-quant-cpu failed due to capacity constraints; routing still prefers gpu-primary
olivia: hypothesis: quantized attention kernel leaking memory on long sequences (>1024) with certain batch mixes. Repro steps recommended in runbook
derek: mitigation options: 1) enable CPU fallback for non-critical routes, 2) disable quant-kernel via runtime flag `--no-quant-attn`, 3) scale eu-west dedicated pool
maria: runbook: canary kernel disable on a single node first. If stable, roll global.
siva: applied canary toggle to inference-eu-2, monitoring metrics
incidents-bot: routing change applied: low-priority routes shifted to cpu-fallback
olivia: post-canary: 502s dropped from ~12% -> 3.8%, p95 latency +70ms from cpu-fallback
derek: scale request submitted (+2 gpu nodes), ETA ~3m. CS notified top impacted customers: acme-fin, docsify
maria: collecting heap profiles when process stable: `heaptrack --pid $(pgrep model-runner) -o /tmp/heap-$(date +%s).gz`
siva: collecting cores + bt for next two restarts, saving to internal incident storage
olivia: temporary action windows: keep cpu-fallback for 45m; if OOMs persist, disable quant kernel globally
derek: handoff to next oncall in 35m. Summary for handoff: likely memory leak in quant attention kernel triggered by long sequences; mitigations: canary kernel disable succeeded, cpu-fallback enabled, +2 nodes scaled; estimated customer impact: peak ~7% of eu-west requests; paged customers updated on status page 01:10 UTC
night-oncall: acknowledged — will monitor 1h and escalate to eng-runtime if OOMs continue. No rolling deploys until cleared
maria: added instrumentation tasks to postmortem: stress tests with long sequences, add allocation caps and early OOM detection in runtime
derek: leaving checklist: collect cores/heapprofiles, reproduce with stress harness, prepare hotpatch to remove quant kernel or add allocation guard
maria: :thumbsup:
